top_signals.title: Trump sees Iran war ending soon after midterm elections, predicts oil prices will then fall sharply
top_signals.summary: Oil prices retreated on Friday on hopes of a resumptions in negotiations, but notched sharp weekly gains after soaring above $100 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Farage’s Reform UK gets $97M from two crypto billionaires
top_signals.summary: Ben Delo, co-founder of BitMEX, donated almost $50 million to Nigel Farage’s Reform UK party, matched a day later by Christopher Harborne.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Larry Ellison cancels $7.5bn Oracle share sale
top_signals.summary: About-face comes a day after a filing revealed plans to sell up to 50mn shares by the end of October

top_signals.title: GitLab urges users to patch max severity path traversal flaw
top_signals.summary: GitLab urged users on Thursday to patch their servers immediately against a maximum-severity path traversal vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-85706. [...]
